# BoldFlow Labs
> AI Automation, Business Systems & Digital Growth Services

BoldFlow Labs (https://www.boldflowlabs.com) is a modern digital systems and business automation agency based in Kerala, India, serving clients globally. We build official Meta WhatsApp Business automations, configure CRM and lead-routing pipelines, manage performance advertising campaigns, engineer high-performance Jamstack websites, and provide technical SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.

## Core Initial Services

### 1. WhatsApp Automation
- Official Meta WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) integration.
- Instant (<5s) automated lead qualification, interactive multi-branch menus, and friction-free inquiry triage.
- Scheduled appointment reminders to reduce consultation no-shows.
- Bidirectional CRM webhooks, multi-agent shared inboxes, and compliant pre-approved message templates.
- URL: https://www.boldflowlabs.com/services/whatsapp-automation

### 2. Business Automation & CRM
- Custom CRM setup and pipeline architecture (HubSpot, Zoho CRM, LeadSquared, Airtable).
- Multi-source lead ingestion from websites, social ads, and inbound communications into unified records.
- Automated round-robin lead routing, instant Slack/WhatsApp team alerts, and multi-step follow-up nurture sequences.
- Error-tolerant webhook automations built with n8n and Make.
- URL: https://www.boldflowlabs.com/services/business-automation-crm

### 3. Performance Marketing
- High-intent Google Search, Performance Max, and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) campaign management.
- Closed-loop attribution via Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google Enhanced Conversions, and server-side Google Tag Manager.
- Search term hygiene, daily negative keyword scrubbing, and conversion-rate-optimized landing page direction.
- Transparent reporting dashboards tracking verified lead acquisition costs.
- URL: https://www.boldflowlabs.com/services/performance-marketing

### 4. SEO Services
- Comprehensive technical SEO audits (crawlability, indexation coverage, canonical alignment, schema validation).
- Core Web Vitals optimization (LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, INP < 200ms).
- High-intent commercial keyword mapping and semantic on-page optimization (H1-H3 hierarchy, internal link architecture).
- Schema.org JSON-LD structured data implementation (Organization, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList).
- URL: https://www.boldflowlabs.com/services/seo-services

### 5. Website Development
- Custom Jamstack websites engineered with Next.js (App Router), React, and TypeScript.
- Sub-100ms global TTFB, zero layout shift (CLS), and Lighthouse 95+ performance benchmarks.
- Frictionless lead-capture forms with honeypot spam protection and instant webhook triggers.
- 100% client asset and code ownership (GitHub repository, domain, and hosting accounts).
- URL: https://www.boldflowlabs.com/services/website-development

### 6. Google Business Profile & Local SEO
- Complete Google Business Profile (GBP) audit, primary/secondary category alignment, and service radius configuration.
- Local citation consistency (NAP) and LocalBusiness Schema.org structured data.
- Friction-free post-service WhatsApp review collection workflows to build genuine, policy-compliant Google reviews.
- URL: https://www.boldflowlabs.com/services/local-seo

## Technology & Tool Ecosystem
- Messaging: Official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API
- CRMs: HubSpot, Zoho CRM, LeadSquared, Pipedrive, Airtable
- Automation: n8n, Make.com, Serverless Webhooks
- Acquisition: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google Tag Manager, GA4
- Web Stack: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
